### What’s Good About Guidde?

#### Easy to Use

Guidde requires minimal setup: sign up, install, and start recording.

Once your content is captured, it’s ready for review, saving you hours of time when you compare it to manual documentation.

Sure, you have to wait a minute or two for the AI to do its thing, but when it’s done, you get an attractive video complete with AI voice-over, along with written instructions and screenshots that have already been annotated for you. [...] Now, maybe that’s on me for expecting too much, or not realizing that Guidde would literally produce a step for every single action I take (even actions that were as simple as entering a user-name and password), but it was still disappointing to have to do so much editing of Guidde’s output in order to simplify things.

Again, this may be less about Guidde itself and more about the nature of AI, but I’d love to see the developers train their AI models even further to work out these kinks.

Or, perhaps better yet, give users some kind of granular control over the level of detail captured so that simple hiccups can be avoided.

results.content:
### Challenge: Difficult Maintenance and Updates

Products change constantly, but updating documentation is so time-consuming that guides quickly become outdated. The effort required to update video guides especially means many organizations simply abandon maintenance, frustrating users with obsolete information.

Guidde Solution: Updating guides is as simple as re-recording the workflow. Guidde regenerates the guide instantly, maintaining all formatting, branding, and structure. Customers report reducing documentation update cycles from weeks to minutes, enabling them to release updated guides simultaneously with product releases.

### Challenge: Poor User Adoption and Support Burden [...] ### Maintenance and Updates

Traditional documentation becomes outdated quickly. Product updates, interface changes, and feature additions require re-creating guides from scratch. The effort is so significant that many organizations simply let documentation drift out of date, frustrating users and increasing support burden. Documentation debt accumulates as the gap between reality and documentation grows.

AI tools make updates effortless. Simply re-record the updated workflow and the AI regenerates the guide instantly, maintaining all formatting and branding. Guidde customers report reducing documentation updates from weeks to minutes, enabling them to keep content current with every product release rather than maintaining legacy documentation.
